The pendulum_lab ↔ resonator_obs correlation (r=0.452) is a genuine weak coupling between these two observables, buried in noise.
Measurement noise dominates signal across all four streams; the pendulum_lab ↔ resonator_obs correlation is a noise-induced false positive (statistical fluctuation at the boundary of expectation).

Trial assignment error or lag-matching artifact: the 3-day offset between pendulum_lab and resonator_obs that produced r=0.452 is an artifact of the lag-search procedure itself (multiple comparisons bias, or misalignment of trial numbering across apparatus).
Residual: an unrecognized systematic (calibration drift in one apparatus, unlogged environmental event, or physical coupling I have not yet modeled).
